toxicities: 与酒精或阿片等抑制剂混用可能致命。
summary: 一种中等时效的处方苯二氮卓。具有镇静和催眠作用，高剂量可能导致抑制解除与失忆。
effectsSummary: Oxazepam has anxiolytic, sedative and relaxing effects. It is a mild to moderately potent benzodiazepine.
generalRisks: Drowsiness, dizziness, impaired coordination. Lower abuse potential compared to other benzodiazepines. Still dangerous with other depressants.
longtermRisks: Regular use leads to dependence. Withdrawal can be severe.
saferUse: 如果在线购买，实际成分可能与标识不同。
